environment.description: Same IoT gateway firmware deployed in industrial facility. Device is placed in a VPC-equivalent isolated VLAN (10.44.128.0/22) configured on Cisco Catalyst 9300 with the following: (1) switchport access vlan 844 with no SVI configured for that VLAN on the L3 switch (no default gateway assigned), (2) inter-VLAN routing explicitly denied via 'no ip routing' on VLAN 844 interface, (3) no NAT/PAT translation rules reference VLAN 844 source addresses in the border ASA 5525-X, (4) the upstream ISP-facing interface ACL (applied inbound on Gi0/0 of the ASA) drops all traffic with source 10.44.128.0/22 as martian. The device can communicate only with other hosts on the same /22 subnet. MQTT broker is a local Mosquitto instance on 10.44.128.5 within the same VLAN. No route exists to any external network from this segment.

config.vlan: 844, no SVI gateway, no inter-VLAN routing
config.nat: no PAT/NAT rules for 10.44.128.0/22 on border firewall
config.acl: ASA outside interface drops 10.44.128.0/22 sourced packets
config.egress_path: none - no default route, no NAT, no proxy, no DNS forwarder to external
